orthology_status: high-confidence closest orthologue; strict one-to-one status not proven
experimental_evidence: Arabidopsis NERD binds histone H3 and AGO2 and defines a noncanonical siRNA-dependent DNA-methylation pathway
interpretation: Direct chromatin-silencing evidence; no direct flowering or life-history evidence

experimental_evidence: Arabidopsis CHR4 interacts with floral-meristem identity factors and regulates floral genes in the inflorescence meristem
interpretation: Strong direct floral-transition and meristem evidence in Arabidopsis

experimental_evidence: Arabidopsis BRM controls shoot and flower development; loss alters flowering time and floral-organ development
interpretation: Strong direct flowering and meristem evidence in Arabidopsis

reference_orthologue: AT1G79000 / HAC1 / Q9C5X9; AT1G16710 / HAC12 / Q9FWQ5
orthology_status: family-level co-orthology; HAC1 is the closest sequence hit but only marginally closer than HAC12
experimental_evidence: Arabidopsis HAC1 mutants flower late and show reduced fertility; this evidence is conditional on the paralogue assignment
interpretation: Strong flowering mechanism at family level; requires a HAC gene tree before gene-specific transfer

orthology_status: EAF1A/B co-orthology; not PIE1 and not uniquely assignable to EAF1A
experimental_evidence: Arabidopsis EAF1 proteins assemble NuA4; reduced EAF1 activity lowers H4K5 acetylation at flowering regulators, lowers FLC, and causes early flowering
interpretation: Strong direct flowering mechanism for the Arabidopsis co-orthologue pair

orthology_status: best OST1A orthologue; strict one-to-one status not proven
experimental_evidence: Arabidopsis OST-complex purification and mutant analysis establish OST1 as an N-glycosylation subunit required for normal growth
interpretation: Direct ER glycosylation evidence; no direct flowering or perenniality evidence

orthology_status: grass gamma-COP co-orthologue; gamma-1 versus gamma-2 assignment is uncertain
experimental_evidence: Arabidopsis gamma-COP knockout has a mild but direct defect in compatible-pollen acceptance
interpretation: Direct reproductive and trafficking evidence, but no flowering-time evidence

orthology_status: family-level assignment with multiple close grass and Arabidopsis paralogues
experimental_evidence: Rice importin-alpha1a is light regulated and has direct NLS-binding, nuclear-import, and structural evidence
interpretation: Strong molecular evidence but weak cargo-specific and life-history interpretation

orthology_status: probable orthologue with a recent Arabidopsis duplication
experimental_evidence: No direct plant SRP72 mutant or biochemical study was located; ER targeting is conserved-family inference
interpretation: Plausible ER-targeting component but weak direct plant experimental support

interpretation: Strong endocytosis and cell-wall mechanism; no direct annual-perennial evidence
